text:
Maria C.: Heads-up: I'm sketching a proposal for adding a 'slowpath' to model admission — basically run a small sample of heavy compatibility checks (KV cache replay, long sequence runs, quant mismatch repro) asynchronously after the quick smoke. Need opinions on scope and failure modes.

Kevin L.: +1. We need clear failure semantics. Treat deterministic numeric mismatches (e.g., max delta > eps) as FAIL; non-deterministic/flaky diffs => WARN. Also log seed/PRNG state.

Raj P.: How big a sample though? Running a full bench on every intake will kill infra. Propose stratified sampling: 10 long-seq traces (to exercise KV cache + attention), 50 short-seq randoms, and replay any golden inputs that the model author provided. Run both float and quantized variant if available.

Jordan: Also resource isolation: run slowpath on a dedicated pool labelled admit-slow. Autoscale min=0, max=2 for now. If queue grows we should backpressure admission but not block quick smoke. Need TTL for cached artifacts produced by slowpath.

Maria C.: For outputs, propose this minimal result schema that onboard-bot will post: artifact_fingerprint, test_vector_ids[], verdict (OK/WARN/FAIL/TIMEOUT), repro_link/logs_url, infra_snapshot. Is that granular enough?

onboard-bot: I can post statuses. Example payload I can emit:
```
verdict: WARN
fingerprint: sha256:abcd1234...
repro-case: https://ci/repro/123
infra: gpu-v100-32gb, quant=4bit
```
Will that work?

Kevin L.: Yes but we should persist raw tensors for repro-case for 30d (or until model version superseded). Also capture chosen kernels, CU availability, and quant flags so we can repro bit-exactly where possible.

Raj P.: Edge case: custom ops in the model. Should slowpath auto-fail or escalate? My vote: mark as MANUAL_REVIEW + include op list and link to runtime compatibility table. Auto-fail only if op missing at runtime.

Maria C.: Runtime policy proposal: if slowpath verdict == FAIL => mark model as 'quarantined' in registry and trigger automatic routing of production traffic to prior stable artifact (canary rollback). If WARN => allow but tag and create an eval job. TIMEOUT => treat as WARN. Thoughts?

Jordan: :thumbsup: Need a playbook doc for oncall: steps to triage FAIL vs MANUAL_REVIEW. Also set SLO: slowpath should complete within 20 minutes for models < 30B parameters. If it exceeds, set verdict=TIMEOUT and surface cost.

Kevin L.: One more: fingerprinting. Normalize exports (strip metadata like timestamps, optimizer state) before sha256 so tiny metadata diffs don't generate false fails. Use a canonical exporter for gguf/onnx before fingerprinting.

Maria C.: Good call. I'll include a small pseudo snippet in the RFC for how teams invoke slowpath: 
```
# run_slowpath.sh
export ARTIFACT=$1
./ci/bench --model $ARTIFACT --traces traces/long.json --quantized true --out=results/
```
I'll also include cost estimates per model (GPU-mins) and an opt-out flag for extremely large models with manual review. Will draft RFC tomorrow and ping for review. Thanks all.

Raj P.: Add a flag to opt-out that requires a mandatory security signoff (for enterprise private deploys). Otherwise looks good.

Maria C.: Will do — adding to RFC checklist.
